title: Learning to Edit IFC Building Models: Verifiable Checkers as the Training Signal for Dependency-Aware Editing Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Editing a building information model in the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) schema requires propagating changes to dependent elements while preserving unrelated entities. Existing language-model agents for IFC editing use prompted models without learning from edit outcomes. Target-file comparisons do not specify which alternative edits are allowed or which unrelated entities must remain unchanged. We present IfcGym, a CodeAct environment in which a language model edits IFC through executable code and four checkers verify validity relative to the input model, intent, dependency and preservation against a task specification. Their conjunction is strict success. IfcEdit distils verified teacher episodes into a Qwen3.5-9B student through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with strict success as the reward. translated_title: 学习编辑IFC建筑模型：可验证检查器作为依赖感知编辑智能体的训练信号
translated_abstract: 在行业基础类（IFC）模式中编辑建筑信息模型，需要在保持无关实体不变的同时，将变更传播到存在依赖关系的元素上。现有的用于IFC编辑的语言模型智能体仅使用提示（prompt）方式驱动，而不会从编辑结果中学习。基于目标文件的比较无法说明哪些替代编辑是允许的，也无法说明哪些无关实体必须保持不变。我们提出了IfcGym，这是一个CodeAct环境，语言模型通过可执行代码编辑IFC，并由四个检查器依据任务规范验证输入模型、意图、依赖与保留方面的有效性，四者的合取构成严格成功。IfcEdit通过监督微调（SFT）将经过验证的教师轨迹蒸馏到Qwen3.5-9B学生模型中，随后应用组相对策略优化（GRPO），以严格成功作为奖励。在IfcEditBench（涵盖13个留出真实项目的1,990个编辑任务）上，最终的学生模型……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出IfcGym环境与IfcEdit训练方法，以四个可验证检查器的合取作为严格成功信号，通过SFT蒸馏与GRPO强化学习训练出能够感知依赖关系、可靠编辑IFC建筑模型的语言模型智能体。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces IfcGym and IfcEdit, which use the conjunction of four verifiable checkers as a strict success reward to train dependency-aware LLM agents for editing IFC building models via SFT distillation and GRPO.
